notes.title: Wander Vyrosa Is Now Free to Play!
notes.notes:
Greetings wanderers! 

With Wander Vyrosa releasing into early access a little over a year ago, we have an exciting announcement:

[h1]Wander Vyrosa Is Now Free![/h1]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

When the initial development of Vyrosa was taking place, the team at Pumpkin House Games was still in college. After the initial release, we had plans to develop the game further and eventually to a full release. After graduation though, we very quickly found ourselves in a position where we didn't have much time to work on the project or the benefit of close-proximity working environment. As a result, the project very quickly lost the development momentum we had worked to maintain.

At this time, we don't have any immediate plans to continue working on Wander Vyrosa. Although we have a lot of ideas we would like to implement, the team has decided to take a step back from the project for now to re-evaluate our goals as a studio moving forward.

With all that being said, we want to extend a [b]huge[/b] thank you to everyone who was involved with the game and playtested during it's development. It was an amazing experience to bring our hobby project to Steam, and we can't wait to work on future projects as a team. [b]Thank you![/b]

If you would like to keep up with our future projects, feel free to checkout our (upcoming) website and various social links below. Until next time, [b] Happy Wandering![/b]

[url=https://twitter.com/pumpkinhousegms]Pumpkin House Games Twitter[/url]
[url=https://pumpkinhousegames.com/coming-soon]Upcoming Pumpkin House Games Website[/url]

notes.title: Wander Vyrosa Version 1.0.1 Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Wanderers!
[/h3]

The past two months have been quite busy for us here at Pumpkin House Games, but we have been able to get some new changes added to Wander Vyrosa! Our main focus was fixing some glaring bugs and balance issues to make the current gameplay more enjoyable. As always, please feel free to join our [url=https://wandervyrosa.com/discord]Discord[/url], visit our [url=https://wandervyrosa.com/support]support page[/url], or create a post in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2118940/discussions/]Steam discussion board[/url] if you have any feedback for the team.

[h3]Happy wandering![/h3]

[h1]v1.0.1 Changelog[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added minion enemies
[*] Added new laser drill animations for planet completion
[*] [b]Experimental[/b] Added basic controller support 
[*] Added progress indicators for laser drill resource gathering 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with 'return to tower' prompt displaying on planets while not near the drop pod
[*] Fixed tower mods disappearing when being swapped/added in the mod menu
[*] Fixed lizard tank animation not displaying properly
[*] Removed lizard tank shields and buffed health
[*] General balance updates
[/list]

notes.title: Development Updates - April 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings wanderers![/h3] 

As we mentioned in previous posts, the Pumpkin House Games team has a lot of work planned for Wander Vyrosa. We've got some great feedback so far since release, and look forward to hearing more! 

Although there is still a lot of testing and iterating we are doing internally, we wanted to update you all on what our goals are moving forward in the form of a (very) loose "development roadmap"! 

[i]Please note that these updates and the actual features are not yet set in stone, so they may change as we continue through the development process.[/i]


Let's get into it!


[h2]Update 1 - Quality of Life and Game Balance[/h2]
Our main goal for our first update is taking what we have already and making it a lot more intuitive and enjoyable to play. After sifting through all the feedback we've gotten and getting the game into the hands of the community, we were immediately made aware of different aspects of the game that felt off- notably the balance of enemies throughout the normal gameplay progression. Now that are core mechanics are more refined than they were previously, our main goal is to balance the game so battles feel fair and exciting to play through.

In addition to balance changes, we also hope to add full native controller support and re-assignable controls during this update! This is something we haven't done quite yet since the actions available to the player have changed quite frequently. Now that we have the core actions better defined however, our goal is to add support for these features to improve the accessibility and customization that Wander Vyrosa offers to players.


[h2]Update 2 - Gameplay Variety[/h2]
For this update, we want to add additional content that builds on the core of Wander Vyrosa and prevents the game from becoming too repetitive. As a result of focusing more on mechanical soundness up to this point, Vyrosa doesn't yet have a ton of content to go along with the core mechanics. However, for our second update our goal is to add more variety to gameplay.

[h3]What will this additional content be?[/h3] 
Although we haven't nailed down exactly [i]what[/i] this content will be yet, we have a few ideas that we want to investigate further:

[list]
[*] Planetary modifiers (i.e low gravity or atmospheric effects) that will modify how each planet feels, and how enemies and towers interact 
[*] Multiple defense modes, such as enemies on some planets following a randomly-generated single path instead of wandering aimlessly until they find the laser drill
[*] Additional towers and mods that provide more options for defense on planets 
[/list]

[h2]Into the Future[/h2]
We hope you are as excited as we are to see new mechanics and content added to the game! As always feel free to join our [url=https://wandervyrosa.com/discord]Discord[/url] and [url=https://wandervyrosa.com/socials]follow us online[/url] to share your thoughts and keep up to date with the latest Wander Vyrosa news! 


[b]Happy wandering![/b]
- [i]Your friends at Pumpkin House Games[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix v0.1.01 - Initial Save Creation Fix
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings Wanderers![/b]

This build is to fix a bug we were recently made aware of, which caused a failure during the initial save creation. As a result, a new run couldn't be started. This appeared to be due to how the game was scanning for save files combined with the auto-generated Steam cloud save data.

The issue should now be fixed, and a default "Wanderer" profile should be created the first time the game is launched.


[b]Happy wandering![/b]
- [i]Your Friends at Pumpkin House Games[/i]

notes.title: Development Updates - February 2023
notes.notes:
Greetings Wanderers!

Welcome to the first Steam post for Wander Vyrosa! As we get ever closer to our official early access launch, we wanted to let you know how development has been going so far and what our plans are moving forward and following early access. To all of you who have wishlisted the game so far, thank you so much for your support! 


[h2]Development Updates[/h2]

Overall we are very happy with the direction Wander Vyrosa development is heading! Most of the development up to this point has been focused mostly on building the core systems and making the game fun to play. However, we are now at the point where we can shift our attention to integrating additional content with our base mechanics! The Pumpkin House Games team is still adjusting to some changes within our work structure that took place around the new year (more info in the blog post linked below), but we are still on track to release in Q2 this year!

[h2]Early Access Release Updates[/h2]

After discussing what we would like to include in our early access release, we have unfortunately had to push back our early-access release date until Q2 2023. This was a difficult decision to make, but we feel that the additional development time will result in a more polished experience at launch.

We are very excited to get the game into your hands as soon as possible, and every decision we make is in support of this goal. If you would like to keep up with development in the meantime, please feel free to follow our social media accounts (links below) and hang out in our Discord channel where you can talk to the developers directly. 


Follow us online: [url=https://wandervyrosa.com/social]https://wandervyrosa.com/social[/url]
Check out our website: [url=https://wandervyrosa.com]https://wandervyrosa.com[/url]

- Pumpkin House Games
